key_findings: FABP5 inhibitor ART26.12 reversed and prevented oxaliplatin-induced neuropathic pain in rats via a CB1-dependent mechanism with possible CB2, PPARalpha and TRPV1 involvement.
ART26.12 raised spinal cord N-acyl amino acids and upregulated PAG ion channels.
